title: Byrna's New CL Mag Defender and CO2 Quick Release Cap
summary: Discover Byrna’s new CL Mag Defender and Quick Release CO2 Cap—designed to help protect your magazine and simplify CO2 cartridge changes for added convenience.
body_markdown:
## New Byrna Accessories: Quick Release CO2 Cap and Magazine Defenders


Being prepared means[having the right equipment](https://byrna.com/collections/byrna-non-lethal-guns) configured for individual needs. Byrna’s newest accessories—the


[Quick Release CO2 Cap](https://byrna.com/products/quick-release-co2-cap?_pos=1&_psq=quick+relea&_psid=3ba5efab7&_ss=e) and


[Magazine Defenders](https://byrna.com/search?type=product&q=Magazine%20Defenders*) —are designed to make Byrna launchers easier to maintain, store, and customize.


## Quick Release CO2 Cap Makes CO2 Changes Easier


The new


**Byrna Quick Release CO2 Cap** provides a faster way to install and remove CO2 cartridges without relying exclusively on the magazine’s built-in hex key.


Its knurled surface is designed to provide additional grip, allowing users to install or remove even partially filled CO2 cartridges by hand. For situations where additional leverage is needed, the Quick Release CO2 Cap also retains the hex key slot.


This updated accessory can simplify routine CO2 changes while giving Byrna owners another way to customize their launcher setup.


## Magazine Defenders Help Protect Stored Magazines


Byrna


**Magazine Defenders** have become a popular accessory for protecting magazines while they are stored and ready for use. Originally available for the HD, SD, and LE launchers, Magazine Defenders are now also available for


**Byrna CL magazines** .


Adding a Magazine Defender provides an additional layer of protection for a stored magazine and helps keep the magazine protected as part of a ready-storage setup.


## Customize a Byrna Setup for Individual Needs


Every personal protection plan looks different. The right accessories can help tailor a Byrna launcher to an individual’s lifestyle, whether that means simplifying CO2 maintenance or protecting magazines during storage.


The Quick Release CO2 Cap and expanded lineup of Magazine Defenders give Byrna owners additional options for maintaining and organizing their equipment.


For anyone looking to enhance their Byrna launcher setup, these accessories provide practical additions designed around


**convenience, maintenance, storage, and preparedness** .
